blocks.text: Ferrofluid ek anokha material (cheez) hai jis mein liquid (behne wali cheez) aur magnet dono ki properties (khaas baatein) hoti hain. Yeh magnetism aur fluid dynamics (behte materials ki motion) ke principles ke mel se kaam karta hai.

Asal mein ferrofluid ek carrier fluid (jaise tel ya pani) mein magnetic particles (nanhe tukre) ka colloidal suspension hai, yani nanhe particles jo liquid mein phaile rehte hain aur neeche nahi baithte. Aam taur par yeh particles iron oxide ke hote hain, nano-scale tak pees kar, taqreeban 10 nanometre ke. In particles par surfactant ki teh (coating) hoti hai; surfactant woh material hai jo surface tension (satah ka khinchao) kam karta hai. Yeh teh particles ko aapas mein chipakne nahi deti aur woh fluid mein barabar phaile rehte hain. Fluid ka viscosity (gaarhapan), particles ka nanometre size aur un ki constant (lagatar) motion (chalna ya hilna) unhein neeche baithne nahi dete.

Jab qareeb koi magnet na ho to ferrofluid aam liquid ki tarah behta hai. Magnet qareeb ho to particles temporarily (thori der ke liye) magnet ban jate hain aur poora fluid magnet ban jata hai. Particles fluid mein structures (banawat) banate hain aur ferrofluid kuch had tak solid jaisa ho jata hai. Magnet hata dein to particles ka magnetism khatam ho jata hai aur ferrofluid phir liquid ban jata hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Pehla ferrofluid NASA ne natural (khud ba khud hone wala) magnetite ko pees kar banaya tha. Ferrofluid is liye invention (nayi cheez banana) hua tha ke space (khala) mein liquids ko motion di ja sake. Kitab is ka saal 1960 likhti hai (neeche dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke pehla ferrofluid NASA ne 1960 mein banaya. Asal mein NASA ke Steve Papell ne yeh 1960s ke shuru mein banaya; us ke tareeqe ka patent 1963 mein darj hua. Is liye 1960 ka saal theek nahi; 'early 1960s (taqreeban 1963)' sahi hai.

Yeh sab magnetic forces, surface tension aur gravity ke muqable ki wajah se hota hai. Strong magnetic field mein magnetic forces fluid ko oopar khainchti hain jabke gravity aur surface tension use neeche khainchte hain; is se zanjeer jaise structures bante hain. Yeh zanjeerein magnetic field lines ke saath seedh mein aa jati hain aur viscosity barha deti hain, aur fluid kuch directions mein solid ki tarah ubhar aata hai. Inhein spikes (kaante) kehte hain. Spikes wahan bante hain jahan magnetic forces baqi forces se zyada taqatwar ho jati hain (Fig. 10.17).

blocks.alt: Saada khaaka: bar magnet (N surkh, S neela) ke oopar rakhi plate par kaala ferrofluid nukeele kaanton (spikes) ki shakal mein khara hai; beech ke kaante sab se oonche hain. Labels: ferrofluid, magnet.
blocks.caption: Ferrofluid ke kaante (spikes) magnet ke oopar: hamara saada khaaka (kitab ki Fig. 10.17 photo hai; yeh us ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnet ki field lines ke saath ferrofluid ke particles zanjeeron mein jur kar oopar khinchte hain, jabke gravity aur surface tension unhein neeche kheenchte hain. Jahan magnetic force jeet jati hai wahan kaante bante hain. Magnet hata dein to particles magnetism kho dete hain aur fluid phir flat (chapta, seedha) liquid ban jata hai.
Neeche wala experiment (kar ke dekhna) yeh asar dikhata hai.
Aap ko chahiye: thora laser printer toner, thora khane ka tel, ek test tube, sheeshe ki bottle, ek chhoti chhari (stick) aur ek magnet.

Test tube mein thora toner dalein. Yaad rahe laser printer toner mein 40 % iron oxide nanometre size ke particles mein hota hai. Is mein khane ka tel dal kar chhari se achhi tarah milayein; ferrofluid ban jayega. Yeh fluid bottle mein dalein. Bottle hilane par fluid liquid ki tarah behta hai. Ab bottle ke bahar se magnet fluid ke qareeb layein.
Aap dekhenge ke fluid magnet ki taraf uchhalta hai, kyunke woh khud magnet ban gaya hai. Magnet ko bottle ki ek taraf pakray rakhein to fluid spikes wala structures bana leta hai (Fig. 10.18).

Ferrofluids electronics, medicine, engineering aur Physics aur Material science ki research (tehqeeq) mein bohat kaam aate hain. Electronics mein yeh computer hard drives aur ghoomti shaft wali motors ki rotary seals mein istemal hote hain. Loudspeakers mein yeh voice coil ko thanda rakhte hain jo chalte waqt garam ho jati hai: magnetic field fluid ko coil ke gird thame rakhti hai, aur fluid heat absorb (andar le lena) kar ke bahar nikalta hai. Speakers mein yeh vibration (kaanpna) kam karte aur awaz behtar karte hain.

Medicine mein ferrofluids ko bahar rakhe magnets se body (jism) ke khaas hisson ki taraf bheja ja sakta hai, yani dawa theek nishane par pohanchana (targeted drug delivery). Magnetic particles dawa seedhe tumour (rasoli) ya kisi aur nishane tak le jate hain, jis se side effects kam aur ilaaj zyada asar-daar hota hai. Ferrofluids magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) mein contrast agents (tasveer saaf karne wali cheezein) ke taur par bhi kaam aa sakte hain.
Doosre istemal: magnetic field badal kar vibration kam karna (damping) ya liquids ke flow (behna) ko theek theek control karna.

blocks.prompt: Ferrofluids kaise kaam karte hain, clear kijiye (comprehensive question 10.6).
blocks.explanation: Iron oxide ke nanometre particles, surfactant ki teh ke saath taa ke alag rahein, tel ya pani mein phaile hote hain. Field na ho to particles random (bina kisi tarteeb ke) hote hain aur liquid aam tarah behta hai. Magnetic field mein har particle nanha magnet ban jata hai; particles field lines ke saath zanjeeron mein seedh mein aate hain, viscosity barhta hai, aur jahan magnetic force gravity aur surface tension se zyada ho wahan liquid spikes ki shakal mein ubhar aata hai. Field hatane par particles magnetism kho dete hain aur fluid phir behta hai.
